articles.title: XRP drifts toward $1.10 support as traders await break from three-week range
articles.snippet: Weak volume and fading momentum kept XRP pinned near the bottom of its recent range, with the $1.05-$1.10 area emerging as the market's key line in the sand.

articles.title: CFTC chair says perp trading not suitable for all assets it regulates
articles.snippet: Michael Selig told US cotton producers that the agency’s regulatory approach to crypto perpetual futures may not be a “natural fit for traditional commodity markets, like agriculture.”

articles.title: THORChain resumes trading more than month after $10M exploit
articles.snippet: THORChain resumed all network activity after implementing multiple security upgrades and a vault migration to fix the vulnerabilities that led to the $10.7 million exploit.

articles.title: Enso launches RWA app and trading for over 500 tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Enso launched access to over 500 tokenized assets and US stocks, citing a growing demand for US equity exposure among European investors.

articles.title: Trump Orders Acceleration of Quantum Readiness as Bitcoin Faces Coming Risk
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump signed two executive orders aimed at expanding U.S. quantum computing capabilities and speeding the transition to quantum-resistant encryption.
